# ECN-2026-033 - Change notice - Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3

Revision: Rev B  
Plant: P2, line P2-L1  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-SB03

Reason for change
- Operational logs and media-performance sampling identified accelerated media degradation in EQ-P2-L1-SB03 leading to reduced blast consistency and increased rework. This ECN standardizes a preventive media top-up schedule to restore process stability and reduce part quality variance. Related process and maintenance alignment required with SB-1031, SOP-P2-L1-01, and SOP-P2-L1-04.

Affected items
- Equipment: EQ-P2-L1-SB03 (Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3).
- Procedures: Operators and maintenance teams must reference SOP-P2-L1-01 for daily operation impacts and SOP-P2-L1-04 for maintenance task integration. Media handling and inventory events must reference SB-1031 for approved media types and handling precautions.
- Work instructions and local control charts for line P2-L1 where blast quality metrics are recorded.

Implementation
- Media top-up interval: The shot media top-up interval for Hot Forge shot blast cabinet #3 (EQ-P2-L1-SB03) is 33 hours. Implement this interval as a scheduled preventive action recorded in the equipment maintenance log and the line P2-L1 shift handover sheet.
- Responsibilities: Production supervisors on P2-L1 to schedule top-up events; maintenance to verify media quantity and condition during scheduled top-ups and document findings in the maintenance log. Update electronic maintenance system entries to reference SB-1031 and link task steps to SOP-P2-L1-01 and SOP-P2-L1-04.
- Training: Brief operators and maintenance personnel on the new interval and documentation expectations during the next shift change meeting; capture acknowledgements in the training log.

Approvals
- Change approved by Production Engineering and Maintenance Management for Plant P2, line P2-L1. Final approval entry must reference this ECN id and attach affected procedure ids SB-1031, SOP-P2-L1-01, SOP-P2-L1-04. Approval signatures and dates to be recorded in the document control system.
